scope.description: Node-level configuration-proposal admission under documented early Advance, with persisted committed first change, delayed but ordered ApplyConfChange, and configuration validation enabled.
assumptions: Node interface early Advance permission applies to a Ready containing configuration entries; no captured exception restricts it to data entries.
Prior configuration is intended to apply, not cancelled.
Target runs serialized Node loop; caller uses no direct state mutations.
excluded: RawNode callers interpreting Advance as completed application.
Consensus safety failure, voter-set replacement, crash recovery and client completion.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target changes; MemoryStorage substitutes completed durability and absent learners receive no network messages.
Separate userApplied counter advances only after caller application/ApplyConfChange; Status.Applied is recorded independently.

plan_uncertainties: The applicability interpretation uses explicit Node early-Advance permission; RawNode completion wording is stronger and not used to authorize the history.
Only local admission of learner changes is measured; safety or availability consequences require a different legal history.
grounding_unresolved: An unstated configuration-specific exception to early Advance would change applicability; it is not present in the captured Node/package contract.
